name: v2_patient_grouped
description: Final GRAPE model comparison using v3-selected low-complexity CFP/ROI configurations with patient-level grouped CV.
notes: All metrics are held-out patient-level grouped 5-fold CV metrics.
All visits from the same subject_id are kept in the same fold.
Linear baselines use no explicit intercept to match the current VCTR design convention.
X uses Level-3 CP reduced features X_star, not raw image tensors.
